tests.reason: GET /api/v1/calendar/conflicts now answers from what the calendar screen shows (recurrence expanded, other lenses and connected calendars as title-less busy time). It is an authenticated read; staging shares the production database and has no member entries to assert on, so the behaviour is pinned by the pure computeConflicts unit tests (boundaries, titles never leak for busy/external, reminders/subscription dates excluded, edit-self exclusion, DST) and the route contract/golden.
